item.title: Flatpak 1.19: what actually changed
item.description: Flatpak 1.19 ships as a beta development release, dominated by nine security fixes and a polkit-authenticated path for system-wide downgrades.

item.title: COSMIC Epoch 1.8.0: what actually changed since 1.7.0
item.description: System76 tagged a coordinated submodule bump centered on a major cosmic-comp compositor overhaul. Tablet emulation, libei pasteboard sharing, rounded window corners, and multi-factor PAM login are the headliners, plus a raft of fixes across applets, files, and the greeter.

item.title: KDE Plasma 6.8 Beta: what actually changed since Plasma 6.7
item.description: The first beta is out, feature freeze started September 10, and the final release lands October 14. Here is everything noteworthy, everything minor, and the bug fixes worth knowing about, sorted into sections you can actually read.

item.title: KDE Plasma 6.7.5: the September bugfix update
item.description: Released September 8, 2026, this is the fifth maintenance update in the Plasma 6.7 series. It brings a month of translation updates and targeted fixes across KWin, Discover, the Task Manager, and system daemons.

item.title: GNOME 51 “A Coruña”: the release candidate
item.description: The 51.rc tarballs shipped the week of August 29, string freeze is in, and the stable 51.0 release lands September 16. Here is what the rc pulled in over the beta, what is already locked, and what is still being chased for the final.

item.title: Arch Linux 2026.09.01: the September ISO in plain language
item.description: First Arch ISO to ship with Linux 7.2.2. GCC 16.2.1, glibc 2.44, Python 3.14.7, mkinitcpio 41.1, NVIDIA 610.57.04, COSMIC 1.7, and KDE Plasma 6.7.4 land in the same snapshot.

item.title: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS: what the first point release actually fixes
item.description: Resolute Raccoon's first point release shipped on August 27 with refreshed ISOs, a stack of desktop and kernel fixes, and security updates through August 25. No new HWE stack, that waits for 26.04.2.

item.title: KDE Plasma 6.8 freeze: what is already locked in
item.description: Soft feature freeze landed August 27, 2026. Plasma 6.8 branches from there, two betas follow, and the final release is due October 14. Here is what is settled so far, sorted into the sections you can read.

item.title: GNOME 51 “A Coruña”: what actually changed since GNOME 50
item.description: Alpha and beta are out, the final release lands September 16. Here is everything noteworthy, everything minor, and the bug fixes worth knowing about, sorted into sections you can actually read.
